titulo: Adapt to the learner's area: sales, customer service, HR, legal, finance and operations
lead: A salesperson doesn't want a lawyer's example, and finance doesn't want a marketing example. The same cycle of delegate, review and approve gets stronger when it uses the task, the vocabulary and the risk of each area. This lesson gives you the adaptation method and a map of INEMA's open courses by area, so you can build the track for each class.
objetivo: build a track for 1 area with tasks, vocabulary, typical risk and INEMA open courses with links.

aprende.t: Which INEMA open course fits each area
The typical risk of each area to use in class

hero_alt: Desk with colored folders side by side and objects from several areas: a headset, a calculator, a book and a catalog.

secoes.sub: From the learner's area to their track. Click each step.

nos.detalhe: Ask (or use the questionnaire from lesson 2): what does the person do every week that they'd like to do faster? In customer service: answering a complaint, logging an exchange, notifying a delay.
Use the real terms of the area in the exercise: order, route, invoice, exchange, default, contract, job opening. The class recognizes their own work and pays attention.

Each area has a mistake that costs a lot: an uncapped discount in sales, personal data in customer service and in HR, confidentiality in legal, payment without segregation of duties in finance. This is the review and approval exercise.
The workshop opens the door; INEMA's free, open courses continue the study. Recommend at most 2 or 3 per area, in the right order, so the person doesn't get lost in the catalog.

secoes.legenda: Task and vocabulary hold attention; the typical risk becomes the approval exercise; the courses keep the study going afterward.

secoes.sub: All free. Click the area to see tasks, risk and courses.

texto: Tasks: preparing a proposal, summarizing a visit, answering a quote request, prioritizing the account list. Typical risk: a discount or deadline outside policy (lab failure F5).
Courses: 8020 — Sales, management and sales strategy · GPT-6 Astra in practice (delegate the whole proposal, with proof).

exemplo.texto: A proposal for a new corner store, using the price table, with no discount above 5% without approval.

texto: Tasks: answering a complaint, notifying a delay, logging an exchange. Typical risk: an order hidden in the customer's message and personal data (failures F6 and F8).
Courses: Agente sob controle · criaagentes: a WhatsApp agent that never makes things up.

exemplo.texto: Review 3 replies prepared by the AI for delay complaints, with planted errors.

texto: Tasks: job description, interview script, preparing a difficult conversation, development plan. Typical risk: an employee's personal data, or a decision about a person, handed over to AI.
Courses: Second Opinion (difficult conversations and developing people) · Companies of 2027 (people, processes and agents).

exemplo.texto: AI helps prepare the conversation; the manager decides about the person.

texto: Tasks: first read of a contract, deadlines, case summary. Typical risk: professional secrecy and sealed cases ending up in the wrong tool.
Course: Agents in the law firm (the agent reads, counts and prepares; the lawyer decides and signs).

exemplo.texto: List the penalty clauses of a fictional contract and check each one against the original text.

texto: Tasks: reconcile a bank statement, collect from a late-paying customer, explain the month's variance. Typical risk: the person who enters also approves, and customer data sent outside without a contract (failure F10).
Courses: Agents in accounting and finance · LOOP-R (improvement with numbers before and after).

exemplo.texto: The agent prepares the payment; a different person approves.

texto: Tasks: map a process, set up an order routine, measure before and after, decide with clarity. Typical risk: automating without a baseline and not knowing whether it helped (failure F11).
Courses: AI Work Architect · Copilot + Agents for Companies · Agent Management: the 7 principles.

exemplo.texto: A foundation for any area: From chat to agent and the Professional 2030 common base.

blocos.rot: Prompt · adapt an exercise to another area
blocos.conteudo:
I have this AI exercise made for the customer service area:
"""<paste the exercise with the answer key>"""

Adapt it for the <sales | HR | legal | finance | operations> area
of a <type and size of company>.
Keep the structure: prompt, the policy that applies, 3 planted errors
(1 invented fact, 1 violated rule, 1 piece of personal data) and answer key.
Use the real vocabulary of the area. Do not use real names, CPFs (Brazilian ID numbers) or data.
At the end, say which typical risk of the area the exercise trains.

secoes.sub: A real area, with links you opened.

exercicios.texto: Choose an area (from a real class or from Horizonte: sales with Patrícia, customer service with Juliana). Fill in the learning path with 3 tasks, the vocabulary, the typical risk and 2 or 3 courses from the map. Open each link before putting it in the learning path.
exercicios.pronto: the learning path is saved, every link opens, and the typical risk has the name of who approves.

exercicios.texto: Use the prompt to adapt exercise 2 from lesson 4 (Review) to the area you chose. Check the answer key the AI returned: it also goes through the 4 questions.
exercicios.pronto: you have 1 exercise for the area with 3 planted errors and an answer key that you checked yourself.

secoes.sub: 3 questions. The explanation appears after your attempt.

perguntas.p: What is the best approval exercise for a finance class?
opcoes: Write a birthday email to customers
The agent prepares a payment and a different person approves
Ask the AI to explain what inflation is
perguntas.explica: The typical risk in finance is the person who enters also approving. The exercise trains segregation of duties, which applies with or without AI.

perguntas.p: Why point to only 2 or 3 courses per area?
opcoes: So the person knows where to go next without getting lost in the catalog
perguntas.explica: A big catalog paralyzes people who are just starting. A clear order and few options keep the studying going.

perguntas.p: In an HR class, the AI suggested which employee to let go. What should you teach?
opcoes: Follow the suggestion, it saw the numbers
AI helps you prepare the conversation; the decision about the person belongs to the manager, and employee data calls for care
perguntas.explica: Decisions about people are not delegated. AI works as a second opinion for thinking and preparing, never for deciding.

itens.texto: Weekly tasks, vocabulary, typical risk, and open courses.
Discounts in sales, data shared in customer service and HR, confidentiality in legal, segregation of duties in finance.
2 or 3 per area, with the link checked.
Delegate, review and approve doesn't change; the example does.
